verdict.rationale: Whether user data can be kept out of model training is a fair privacy question for an AI assistant and API platform like Kimi, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a training opt-out, a data-usage control or a no-training policy. The project-level key, IP-whitelist and budget controls are adjacent administrative features and do not address training use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
